chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman about 27 years old wearing a mustard-yellow hijab, a long olive-green coat and a small brown crossbody bag
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan young man about 24 with short black hair and light stubble, wearing a red hoodie with white drawstrings and grey jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her late 50s wearing a burgundy patterned house djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Casablanca family apartment, seen from the hallway where the BROTHER stands half in frame on the left: the SISTER is already at the front door, hand on the handle, leaving in a hurry and glancing back nervously over her shoulder, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. Warm evening light, simple tiled floor.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Happy flashback: the SISTER laughing while sitting at a low round Moroccan table with the MOM and the BROTHER, a teapot and bread on the table, cosy small living room with banquette sofas, warm golden light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The MOM standing at the window of the small apartment, holding the curtain aside and looking down at the empty street with a worried face, an empty glass of tea on the table behind her, dusk light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER standing in the entrance with her shoes still on and her bag on her shoulder, checking her phone nervously, while the MOM holds out a glass of mint tea to her, puzzled. Small hallway of a Moroccan apartment.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER sitting silently on a Moroccan banquette sofa, staring down into her glass of tea with a sad, absent look, face visible; the BROTHER sits across the room watching her, frowning, confused. Quiet living room, soft lamp light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER alone inside an unfinished concrete room: bare grey walls, exposed bricks, cement bags and a single hanging bulb; she looks around the empty space with a worried, tired face, holding her bag strap.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Wide shot of a dusty unpaved street on the far edge of Casablanca lined with unfinished informal houses with rebar sticking out of the roofs, at dusk; the SISTER walks alone in the middle carrying plastic grocery bags, small in the frame but face visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER walking quickly down a narrow dark dusty alley between unfinished brick houses at night, clutching her bag to her chest, glancing behind her anxiously, a stray dog lying by a wall, one weak street lamp.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The SISTER standing alone at a deserted roadside taxi stop at night on the outskirts of Casablanca, tired and worried, holding her phone, an old white grand taxi approaching in the distance with its headlights on.

scenes.name: n10.png
scenes.scene: At night in the family apartment, the MOM and the BROTHER sit side by side on the sofa and look at each other with suspicious, worried faces; on the shelf behind them a framed photo of the SISTER smiling. Dim lamp light.
